messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

Here’s a quick‑look list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can take advantage of in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a weekday that is adjacent to a weekend, or the holiday itself is on a weekend and the day‑off is observed on the nearest weekday.)

| Date | Holiday | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|------|---------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| **Jan 1 2023** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed on **Jan 2 2023** (Monday) | **Jan 1–3** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Feb 20 2023** (Monday) | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PEI, SK) | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Apr 7 2023** (Friday) | Good Friday | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22 2023** (Monday) | Victoria Day | – | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Jul 1 2023** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Observed on **Jul 3 2023** (Monday) | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4 2023** (Monday) | Labour Day | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Oct 9 2023** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Nov 11 2023** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | – | **Nov 9–11** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Dec 25 2023** (Monday) | Christmas Day | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Dec 26 2023** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day | – | **Dec 24–26** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |

### How to use this list

- **Plan trips** around the long‑weekend spans (e.g., Jan 1–3, Jul 1–3, etc.) to maximize travel days without taking extra vacation days.
- **Adjust for provincial differences**: Family Day dates vary by province; the table above lists the provinces that observe it on Feb 20. If you’re in a province that doesn’t observe Family Day, you can skip that entry.
- **Combine with other holidays**: If you’re traveling in late December, you can combine the Christmas/Boxing Day long weekend with the New Year’s holiday for a longer break.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or spreadsheet. If you need the same information for a different year or additional details (e.g., provincial variations), just let me know!
